title: A city-building game in which the city would prefer you didn't
summary: A satirical city-building browser game that mocks NIMBYism by forcing players to fight against existing residents who oppose new housing construction, turning urban planning frustration into gameplay mechanics.
problem_solved: Illustrates the absurdity of housing opposition and NIMBY policies through an interactive, humorous gameplay experience.
why_valuable: Transforms a serious housing policy issue into an engaging game that makes complex urban planning problems accessible and entertaining while delivering a pointed social commentary.
